name: cyberprompt
description: Automatic advisory prompt optimizer for Claude Code. Before a non-agentic, tool-less claude -p rewrite, its private input drops exact whole-line Whisper credit artifacts and collapses runs of 3+ identical lines. The optimizer handles replacement self-repairs, preserves questions and hedges, and permits bounded ASR surface repair. Deterministic schema, source-quote, length, and content-token retention gates fail open to the authoritative original; deliberate token drops must be recorded as assumptions. Includes bounded reference-resolution context, prompt-cached guidance, WORDRUNNER.EXE narration, and XP.
